title: Market Sentiment Probe: Model Supply & Edge Adoption Signals
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Run a short, mixed-methods probe to capture supplier market sentiment and customer adoption signals specifically for low-latency / edge RAG and short-context inference use cases. The goal is to produce a prioritized list of emergent model supply risks and opportunity signals that feed into the model procurement and fallback playbooks.
background: We have a growing number of customers building RAG and edge agents that are latency-sensitive and operate in small-context windows. Existing model scouting artifacts focus broadly on model capabilities and price points; we lack a focused feed of supply-side sentiment and buyer friction for edge scenarios (availability, quantization readiness, regional packaging). This probe will bridge telemetry, buyer interviews, and supplier signal scraping to create actionable triggers for PM and Sales.
objectives: Map short-term supply risk for edge-ready model variants across key regions (NA, EU, APAC)
Quantify procurement friction and integration cost for customers wanting private/deployed variants (VPC, on-prem) for edge-like constraints
Create a small-scope signal feed that can trigger 3 operational actions: (1) pre-provision Dedicated capacity, (2) promote quantized fallback variants, (3) surface procurement alerts to sales
success_metrics: Signal feed precision: >= 70% of surfaced signals validated by customer interviews or supplier announcements within 14 days
Turnaround: actionable triage created for top-5 signals within 10 days of detection
Adoption: Sales/SEs use the feed in at least 4 active enterprise deals in the probe window
deliverables: Weekly signal digest (short) and ranked playbook actions
Consolidated probe workbook (Confluence) with interview notes and telemetry queries
Dashboards: regional supply heatmap and procurement friction index (Grafana/Looker link)
Runbook for automated scraping + heuristic scoring (owner: Data Science)
approach: Mixed-methods: 1) instrument internal telemetry for edge-sensitive calls (token distribution, tail latency by region), 2) run synthetic short-context workloads against candidate open models (quantized and FP16 variants) to measure latency/compatibility, 3) conduct targeted buyer interviews with 8 existing customers and 4 prospects about procurement friction and fallback tolerance, 4) scrape vendor channels (release notes, GitHub, model hubs) for availability and packaging signals, 5) synthesize into a ranked signal feed + playbook.
experiment_plan: Week 1: Kickoff, define telemetry queries, identify 12 candidate model variants and regions
Week 2: Run synthetic microbenchmarks (50k short-context calls) across variants; capture P50/P95 latency, token cost and memory footprints
Week 3: Buyer interviews (8 customers, 4 prospects); inventory integration blockers and procurement window lengths
Week 4: Scoring, generate digest, present to Sales and Runtime Eng for operational triggers
data_sources: Internal production telemetry (route-level latency, token counts) - query saved as prod.edge_latency_2026
Public signals: model hub release RSS, vendor announcement feeds, community forum lurkings
Customer interviews and SE notes (Drive folder)
dependencies: Legal: NDA clearance for sharing prospect interview notes
acceptance_criteria: Signal feed prototype (CSV+API) published to the probe Drive folder
Confluence workbook with interview transcripts (redacted) and synthetic benchmark results published
Runbook with scoring logic and an owner assigned for ongoing maintenance
Presentation to Sales/SEs and Runtime Eng with clear ask(s) and handoff items
